blind.description: An ornate classic side chair with a reddish-brown mahogany wood frame and dark olive-green leather upholstery. It features turned front legs with gold-capped feet, curved rear legs, lower stretchers, a square padded seat lined with decorative brass upholstery studs, and an oval padded backrest framed by a carved wooden crest. The mesh is solid, continuous, and clean with no floating parts or mesh distortions.
blind.from_above: A square dark olive-green seat cushion flanked at the rear by the curved reddish-brown top rail of the chair back.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3 feet tall) and about 1.5 to 2 feet wide.
